findings.statement: At least five separate SBI-group legal entities published XRP shareholder-benefit programs for the 2026 cycle: SBI Holdings, SBI Shinsei Bank, SBI Global Asset Management, SBI ARUHI and SBI Insurance Group.
The shareholder-benefit programs are separate legal-entity programs with different record dates, holding periods and coupon values; recipient populations may overlap and must not be summed.
SBI VC Trade's historical XRP/JPY leveraged-trading campaign advertised a JPY 0.5 standard spread from June 22 to July 3, 2026, subject to widening during volatile conditions.
The SBI Shinsei deposit campaign's May voucher email and July 2 XRP valuation reference do not by themselves prove an internal contradiction; redemption timing remains unresolved.

SBI VC Trade's two-million registered account count, card rewards, points redemptions and shareholder coupons establish distribution reach and product availability, not XRP-specific active users or net spot demand.

feature_admission.reason: No issuer-level redemption totals, XRP procurement source, execution venue, active-XRP-account count or reconciled spot executions.

forecast.reason: Distribution programs and promotional spreads do not establish incremental net spot demand or a calibrated price signal.

Obtain SBI Shinsei Bank coupon redemption instructions and actual fulfillment totals.
